mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_audit_log ( user_id, account, role, login_type, success, failure_reason, ip, user_agent, session_id, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{account}, #{role}, #{loginType}, #{success}, #{failureReason}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{sessionId}, NOW() )
mapper.sql: l.id AS id, l.user_id AS userId, l.account AS account, l.role AS role, l.login_type AS loginType, l.success AS success, l.failure_reason AS failureReason, l.ip AS ip, l.user_agent AS userAgent, l.session_id AS sessionId, l.create_time AS createTime, u.username AS username
mapper.select: SELECT FROM login_audit_log l LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE l.role IS NULL OR l.role != 2 ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM login_audit_log WHERE role IS NULL OR role != 2
SELECT FROM login_audit_log l LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE l.role = 2 ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM login_audit_log WHERE role = 2
